view: Frontal chest radiograph, labelled PA (scapulae project over the lung fields and a chest tube is in place, so likely AP/semi-erect); L marker on image right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate exposure and inspiration; apices and costophrenic angles included; mild rotation possible; right upper thorax partly obscured by clavicular hardware

devices.type: Chest tube (pleural drain), hollow tube with parallel walls and lucent lumen
devices.location: Left hemithorax, coursing from the inferomedial left chest (projecting over the left mediastinal/cardiac border at about T8-T9) obliquely upward and laterally, tip at the left lung apex

devices.type: Orthopedic fixation plate with multiple screws (clavicle ORIF)
devices.location: Right clavicle, along its mid/lateral shaft
Lateral right clavicle / acromion (right shoulder), directed medially

devices.type: Small metallic density (possible suture anchor or small hook, uncertain)
devices.location: Just inferior to the right clavicular plate, right upper chest

devices.type: External L side marker with technologist initials
devices.location: Image upper right corner, patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Large pneumothorax: lateral hemithorax completely lucent with no lung markings from apex to near the base, visible visceral pleural (lung) edge, maximal interpleural distance about 8 cm at hilar level; persists despite the chest tube
Collapsed/retracted left lung lying against the mediastinum, with a rounded lucency within the collapsed lung medially (hilar structure vs bulla/cyst, uncertain)
Hazy increased density of the lower zone near the costophrenic angle, possible small pleural fluid (hydropneumothorax) or compressed lower lobe, uncertain
Clavicle fracture status post plate-and-screw fixation (extra-thoracic)
No definite mediastinal shift or tension features: trachea near midline, hemidiaphragms at similar levels; right lung normally aerated without pneumothorax

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（標示為PA，但肩胛骨重疊於肺野且已置入胸管，較可能為AP攝影），影像右上角可見L側別標記。左側胸腔可見大量氣胸，自肺尖至近橫膈之外側肺野完全透亮、無肺紋理，內側可見塌陷之左肺邊緣，肋膜分離最寬約8公分；左側已置入一條胸管，管尖位於左肺尖，但氣胸仍持續存在。右肺擴張良好、未見氣胸，右鎖骨可見骨板及多枚螺釘固定（骨折術後），外側另有兩枚長螺釘。氣管大致居中、未見明顯縱膈偏移或張力性氣胸徵象；左下肺野近肋膈角處略模糊，不排除少量肋膜積液。
